title: "About Me"

I am a Master of Applied Economics and Data Science (MAEDS) student at the University of Pennsylvania, with a background in Economics from the University of Florida. My interests lie at the intersection of economics, data analytics, finance, and strategic decision-making.

Through experience in consulting, investment research, and wealth management, I have developed strong analytical and research skills. I enjoy transforming complex data into actionable insights and using quantitative methods to address real-world business and financial challenges.
